description: Opens the eight single-kind fixtures read-only and asks: metadata of each table and its Field2 properties (Type, IsComplex, Size, Properties), the catalog (MSysComplexColumns, MSysObjects, including shared type tables), and the group of p1 (two values) and p2 (none) read to EOF with each child field's Name, Type and typed Value.

args.text: SELECT Id, ParentId, Name, Type, Flags, ForeignName FROM MSysObjects ORDER BY Id
